manifest.name: dsh-print-screen
manifest.description: Freezes the whole desktop from a scissors button in the DSH composer, crops a dragged region, and inserts it into the prompt as an image attachment. The shot is stored once in the DSH attachment library, indexed per session. Windows only.
manifest.author: zrrrrrrr77

bundle.text:
# dsh-print-screen bundle patch.
#
# 这个包被某个 profile 选为组合包（package.json 的 dsh.profile.bundles）时，
# 下面这一行会被插入该 profile 的 loader —— 这就是 `dsh plugin add dsh-print-screen`
# 装完之后插件自动生效的原因。
- insert:
    - id: screenshot
      name: dsh-print-screen

readme.text:
[English](README.en.md) | 中文

`dsh-print-screen` 给 DSH 桌面版的输入框加一个剪刀按钮：点一下把整个虚拟桌面（所有显示器）按原位置、原像素冻结，在画面上拖一个矩形，松手后把该区域作为图片附件插入当前提示词框。截图只存一份，放在 DSH 附件库里（按内容哈希命名），不会复制到工作区。仅 Windows。

```text
输入框左下角：  [+]  [✂]  [工作区内修改]  [计划]
                     │
                     └─ 点剪刀 → 屏幕冻结（原位、原大小）→ 拖框 → 松手 → 缩略图进输入框
```

- **一个剪刀按钮**：和普通的输入框按钮一样——透明背景、只有图标，不占额外宽度。
- **冻结屏幕再拉框**：整块虚拟桌面（所有显示器）冻结，每张画面**保持原位、保持原始像素大小**；松手即裁剪并插入。
- **默认隐藏 DSH**：截图前先隐藏 DSH 窗口，截完立即还原（最大化状态也还原），因此能截到被它挡住的窗口。
- **不隐藏的两种方式**：按住 `Shift` 点剪刀，或按 `Ctrl+Shift+Alt+1`。
- **插入提示词框**：走会话自己的附件 API，缩略图出现在输入框下方，回车随消息发出；失败时退回合成粘贴事件，再不行就复制到剪贴板并提示 `Ctrl+V`。
- **文件名带时间戳**：附件名是 `screenshot-2026-10-26_22-31-05.png`（本地时间，精确到秒），多张截图不会重名。
- **只存一份，不重复占空间**：图片以内容哈希命名，存在 DSH 附件库（`~/.dsh/attachments`），工作区里不产生副本；同一张图传两次也只存一份。
- **按会话记账（只在图片真进了消息之后）**：截图成功但没插进输入框（放弃、插入失败、只落到剪贴板）时**不记账**，所以 `screenshots.json` 里的每一条都对应一条看得见的附件。每条记录含时间、文件名、sha256、尺寸、会话 id/标题、`via`（`attached`＝走官方附件通道，`pasted`＝走合成粘贴事件），以及 `object`——它只在附件库文件真的存在时才写路径，否则是 `null`，不会让你拿着一个不存在的路径去反查。
- **可选额外备份**：把 `client.js` 里的 `SAVE_TO_SESSION` 改成 `true`，会在会话文件夹里再存一份同名 png（代价是每张图占双份空间）。

| 操作 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| 单击剪刀 | 截屏，先隐藏 DSH 窗口 |
| `Shift` + 单击剪刀 | 截屏，不隐藏 DSH（可以连它一起截） |
| `Ctrl+Alt+1` | 同单击：截屏并隐藏 DSH |
| `Ctrl+Shift+Alt+1` | 截屏但不隐藏 DSH |
| 拖框 → 松手 | 裁剪、插入当前输入框，并在 `screenshots.json` 记一笔（DSH 窗口在裁剪完立即还原） |
| `Esc` / 右键 | 取消 |

> 快捷键用物理键位判断（`event.code`），`Shift+1` 打出 `!` 的布局也能触发；`!` 本身不做兼容。

每次截图不再重新起 `powershell.exe`（那要付约 1.2 秒的进程启动 + 程序集加载，火绒还会再扫一遍）。改成 DSH 启动后 2.5 秒（避开启动高峰）在后台拉起一个**常驻截图助手** `helper.ps1`，WinForms / DPI / P-Invoke / 位图缓冲只初始化一次，之后每次只需要：

| 阶段 | 耗时（实测） |
|---|---|
| 助手启动（每次 DSH 启动只一次，后台） | ~1.4s |
| 点击 → 冻结画面出现（热态） | ~0.15s（关掉该窗口的 DWM 过渡后 SW_HIDE 瞬时生效，只等 30ms；画面用 BitBlt 直贴，首次绘制 ~40ms） |
| 第一次请求（含首次绘制 JIT） | ~0.3s |
| 拖框 → 返回裁剪图 | 保存约 0.02s + 传输/插入 |

具体做法：截图走 `BitBlt` 直接拷进常驻的 DIB（比 GDI+ 逐屏 `CopyFromScreen` 快 30–40ms）；隐藏 DSH 用瞬时的 `SW_HIDE`（`SW_MINIMIZE` 有 150–250ms 动画）；窗体、画笔字体、位图缓冲全部跨请求复用，整套流程只有 `helper.ps1` 一个实现。

助手起不来或中途挂掉时，宿主会自动重启它再试一次，而不是维护第二套截图脚本。

| 项目 | 要求 |
|---|---|
| DSH | `>= 0.2.1-rc.3`（`engines.dsh`） |
| 系统 | **仅 Windows**（10/11，需要系统自带的 Windows PowerShell 5.1 + System.Drawing/WinForms） |
| 其它 | 无 Node 原生模块、无外部服务、无 API Key |
```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-print-screen

readme.section: 或直接从 GitHub 源码安装
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:zrrrrrrr77/dsh-print-screen
```

也可以在 DSH 里打开 **插件 → 发现**，用插件市场安装。

装完在输入框左侧、「工作区内修改」左边就能看到剪刀；看不到就刷新页面，必要时完全退出 DSH 再打开（宿主半边要重启才加载）。

> `dsh plugin --profile web` 里的 `web` 换成你自己的 profile 名；DSH 桌面版的 profile 由应用管理，建议直接在应用内的插件页安装。

- **DPI 是关键**：截图脚本必须声明 **Per-Monitor V2 DPI 感知**。不声明时 Windows 会把进程按 250% 虚拟化，冻结画面被整体放大 2.5 倍——用户看到的就是「屏幕被放大、不是原样」。声明后所有坐标都是物理像素，显示与鼠标位置 1:1。
- 抓图用 `BitBlt` 逐屏直拷进常驻的 DIB（比 GDI+ `CopyFromScreen` 快 30–40ms），屏幕尺寸变了才重建缓冲。冻结窗口也在 `Paint` 里用 `BitBlt` 直接把 DIB 贴到窗口 DC，而不是 `BackgroundImage`——后者整屏首次绘制要 ~500ms，拖框时会明显卡住。
- 隐藏 DSH 前先 `DwmSetWindowAttribute(hwnd, DWMWA_TRANSITIONS_FORCEDISABLED, TRUE)` 关掉这个窗口的 DWM 过渡，`SW_HIDE` 就变成瞬时的；再等 **30ms** 让合成器出一帧，然后抓屏（不关过渡时窗口会渐隐 ~200ms，40ms 抓到的还是半透明残影）。窗口匹配取两条线索的并集：**进程名**是 `DeepSeek Harness` 的所有可见顶层窗口，以及**标题以 `DeepSeek Harness` 结尾**的窗口——实测 DSH 主窗口的宿主进程未必叫这个名字，只按进程名会一个窗口都匹配不到，DSH 就留在冻结画面里。截完按各自原状态 `SW_SHOW` / `SW_SHOWMAXIMIZED` 还原。
- 隐藏后再检查一次：如果仍有窗口可见（隐藏没生效），就把它的矩形从冻结画面里涂掉，保证截图里永远不会出现 DSH。
- 隐藏/还原的窗口列表用 `ArrayList` 以参数传入（`Get-TargetWindows -Into`），不让函数直接 `return` 集合——PowerShell 会把单元素集合展开成单个对象，只匹配到主窗口时还原逻辑会整段失效（表现为截图后 DSH 停在任务栏、必须手点图标）。还原后还会 `SwitchToThisWindow` + `SetForegroundWindow` 把主窗口切回前台。
- 框选区域**不压暗、不画阴影**，只描一圈清晰的双色边框（外黑内蓝），任何背景下都能看清边界。
- DSH 桌面版的 Host 是独立的 node 进程，没有 `desktopCapturer`，渲染层又被 `contextIsolation` 隔离且禁用 display media，所以「冻结 + 拉框」交给随包发布的 `helper.ps1` 完成。
- 插入图片的三条通道：`ctx.get('conversation').createDrafts()` + `inputActions.addAttachments()`

- 截图**只在本机流转**：宿主进程调用 `powershell.exe` 起一个 WinForms 全屏窗口，画面只在内存里；选完的裁剪结果交给 DSH 附件库保存，临时目录里的中转文件读回浏览器后立即删除。插件没有网络请求。
- 插件会以你的用户权限执行 `powershell.exe -File helper.ps1 -ExecutionPolicy Bypass`（脚本随包发布，可自行审查）；它只隐藏/还原**进程名或窗口标题匹配 DSH** 的窗口，不会碰别的程序。
- 插入图片复用 DSH 自己的附件通道，图片和普通粘贴的图片走同一条上传/落盘路径。
- **本地留痕只有三处**：附件库里的图片本体；会话目录的 `screenshots.json`（文件名、哈希、尺寸、会话标题——用来回答“这张图属于哪个对话”）；`%TEMP%\dsh-print-screen-helper.log`（只记耗时、隐藏窗口数量和**标题长度**，不记标题内容）。
- **诊断开关默认关闭**：只有设置环境变量 `DSH_SCREENSHOT_FRAME_DUMP=1` 后，在**取消**截图时才会把整块冻结画面存到 `%TEMP%\dsh-print-screen-last-frame.png`，用于排查“DSH 有没有被截进去”。
- **截图会离开本机**：图片作为消息附件发送时，会随对话内容一起发给模型服务商。那是 DSH 本身的行为，不是这个插件联网。

```sh
node test.mjs          # 路由注册、跨站拒绝、真实截一张（-SelfTest 固定裁剪，不弹窗）
node test-client.mjs   # 按钮结构、Shift / Ctrl+Alt+1 快捷键判定、时间戳文件名
node test-route.mjs    # 集成：真实路由 + 常驻助手 + 模拟拖框，量冷/热延迟
node --check client.js

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File test-helper.ps1   # 常驻助手：启动耗时、热态延迟、模拟拖框
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File test-hide.ps1     # 用一个替身窗口验证「隐藏 / 还原」
```

助手协议支持自测模式（第 6 个字段为 `1`，不弹窗口、固定裁 320×200），`node test.mjs` 用的就是它。
> **改脚本注意**：所有 `.ps1` 必须存成 **UTF-8 带 BOM**。Windows PowerShell 5.1 对没有 BOM 的脚本按系统 ANSI 代码页（中文系统是 GBK）解码，冻结画面左上角那行「拖动框选区域 · Esc 取消」就会变成乱码。

- 仅 Windows。
- 冻结窗口是普通 TopMost 窗口，理论上可能被其他 TopMost 窗口盖住一角。
- 截图期间 DSH 会被隐藏；如果助手卡死（5 分钟超时会被杀掉），DSH 需要手动还原。
- **不要手动删附件库里的图片**：消息里存的是哈希引用，删掉对象会让对应会话报错、历史图片无法显示。要清理就用「删除会话」插件，让图片随会话一起删。
- **实战案例 ①：删掉附件库里的对象，那个会话就报废了（实测）。** 把 `~/.dsh/attachments/v1/objects/` 下一个被消息引用的对象文件改名，历史里那张图立刻变成「图片加载失败」占位；再发任何一句话，模型请求连续重试 5 次后失败，界面只写 `DeepSeek Messages transport failed`——**从这句错误里完全看不出是附件缺失**。图片按哈希引用，删对象等于把消息里的一段内容抽走，而且没有回收站；这种会话恢复不回来，只能整条删掉（用「删除会话」插件）。
- **实战案例 ②：截图途中助手被杀，DSH 停在隐藏状态。** 截图时 DSH 是用 `SW_HIDE` 隐藏的，正常情况下裁剪完立刻还原。但如果这期间助手进程被结束（任务管理器、杀毒软件拦截、或卡住 5 分钟被超时杀掉），隐藏状态就不会还原——任务栏里看不到窗口，看起来像 DSH 崩了。此时到任务管理器结束 `DeepSeek Harness` 进程，重新启动即可，不用重装、配置也不会丢。

| 版本 | 变化 |
| --- | --- |
| 0.4.10 | 仅打包：`shot-freeze.png` 补进 `files[]`。0.4.9 的包里只有 9 个文件，而 `screenshots.json` 列了两张图，读这份清单的地方第二张预览图会读不到。代码与 0.4.9 完全一致。 |
| 0.4.9 | 修六个问题：① 账本改为「图片真进了消息后由客户端回调 `/record` 才写」，不再留下指向空对象的假记录；② 账本写入串行化，连拍不再丢条目；③ `object` 只在附件库文件真实存在时写路径；④ `Ctrl+Alt+1` 先 `preventDefault`，按钮尚未挂载时不再把按键漏给浏览器；⑤ 快捷键改为按**当前焦点**判断目标会话，点侧栏切换会话后不会再插进上一个会话的输入框；⑥ `helper.ps1` 自测模式也会还原窗口（原来会把 DSH 留成透明层：看不见但还能点到），且还原后再出异常不会二次抢焦点。另：`workingDirectory` 改成运行时可选获取（宿主不再硬注入），会话目录副本拒绝 `..` 开头的怪文件名。 |

[中文](README.md) | English

`dsh-print-screen` adds one scissors button to the DSH composer. Click it and the whole virtual desktop (every monitor) freezes at its original position and pixel size; drag a rectangle on that frozen image, release, and the crop is inserted into the prompt as an image attachment. The shot is stored once, in the DSH attachment library under a content hash, and is not copied into the workspace. Windows only.

```text
composer, bottom left:  [+]  [✂]  [workspace edits]  [Plan]
                           │
                           └─ click ✂ → screen freezes (same place, same size) → drag → release → thumbnail lands in the composer
```

- **One scissors button.** Same as any other composer button: transparent background, icon only, no extra width.
- **Freeze first, then drag.** The entire virtual desktop (all monitors) is frozen, each screen keeping its original position and pixel size; releasing the mouse crops it and inserts the result.
- **DSH hidden by default.** The DSH window is hidden before the shot and restored right after it (maximized state included), so windows it was covering can be captured.
- **Two ways to keep it visible.** Hold `Shift` while clicking, or press `Ctrl+Shift+Alt+1`.
- **Inserted into the composer.** The shot goes through the session's own attachment API, so the thumbnail appears under the input and is sent with the message on Enter. If that fails it falls back to a synthetic paste event, and finally to the clipboard with a `Ctrl+V` hint.
- **Timestamped filenames.** Attachments are named `screenshot-2026-10-26_22-31-05.png` (local time, second precision), so several shots never collide.
- **One copy, no duplication.** The image is stored once in the DSH attachment library (`~/.dsh/attachments`), named by its content hash; no copy is written into the workspace, and uploading the same

| Action | Behavior |
|---|---|
| Click the scissors | Capture, hiding the DSH window first |
| `Shift` + click | Capture without hiding DSH (it can be in the shot) |
| `Ctrl+Alt+1` | Same as a click: capture with DSH hidden |
| `Ctrl+Shift+Alt+1` | Capture with DSH visible |
| Drag a rectangle, release | Crop, insert into the composer, and append a line to `screenshots.json` (DSH is restored as soon as the crop returns) |
| `Esc` / right-click | Cancel |
> Hotkeys match physical keys (`event.code`), so they also fire on layouts where `Shift+1` produces `!`; `!` itself is not handled.

Each capture no longer spawns a fresh `powershell.exe` (about 1.2 s of process start plus assembly load, and antivirus scans it again). Instead, 2.5 s after DSH starts — deliberately past the startup spike — the host launches a **persistent screenshot helper**, `helper.ps1`, so WinForms, DPI, P/Invoke and the bitmap buffer are initialized once. After that a capture costs:

| Stage | Measured |
|---|---|
| Helper start (once per DSH start, in the background) | ~1.4 s |
| Click → frozen desktop visible (warm) | ~0.15 s (with the window's DWM transitions disabled, `SW_HIDE` is immediate and only 30 ms is awaited; the frame is blitted straight in, first paint ~40 ms) |
| First request (includes the first-paint JIT) | ~0.3 s |
| Drag → cropped image returned | ~0.02 s to save, plus transfer and insertion |

The capture path is `BitBlt` straight into a persistent DIB (30–40 ms faster than GDI+ `CopyFromScreen` per screen); hiding uses `SW_HIDE`, which is immediate, where `SW_MINIMIZE` costs a 150–250 ms animation; window, fonts, pens and bitmap buffers are reused across requests. There is only one implementation, `helper.ps1`.

If the helper cannot start or dies mid-request, the host restarts it and retries rather than maintaining a second screenshot script.

| | |
|---|---|
| DSH | `>= 0.2.1-rc.3` (`engines.dsh`) |
| OS | **Windows only** (10/11, using the built-in Windows PowerShell 5.1 and System.Drawing/WinForms) |
| Other | No native Node modules, no external service, no API key |
```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-print-screen

dsh plugin --profile web add github:zrrrrrrr77/dsh-print-screen
```

You can also open **Plugins → Discover** in DSH and install it from the plugin market.

After installing, the scissors sits at the left of the composer, just before "workspace edits". If it is missing, refresh the page; if it is still missing, quit DSH completely and start it again, because the host half only loads on restart.
> Replace `web` in `dsh plugin --profile web` with your own profile name. A desktop build manages its profile itself, so install from the plugin page inside the app instead.

- **DPI is the whole game.** The capture script must declare **Per-Monitor V2 DPI awareness**. Without it Windows virtualizes the process at 250% and the frozen image is scaled up 2.5x — which users see as "the screen got bigger", not a 1:1 copy. With it every coordinate is a physical pixel and the display matches the mouse exactly.
- Captures `BitBlt` each screen straight into a persistent DIB (30–40 ms faster than GDI+ `CopyFromScreen`), rebuilding the buffer only when the screen size changes. The freeze window also blits the DIB into its device context inside `Paint` instead of using `BackgroundImage`, whose first full-screen paint takes ~500 ms and visibly stalls the drag.
- Before hiding, the host calls `DwmSetWindowAttribute(hwnd, DWMWA_TRANSITIONS_FORCEDISABLED, TRUE)` to disable DWM transitions for that window, which makes `SW_HIDE` immediate; it then waits **30 ms** for the compositor to produce a frame before capturing (without that the window fades out over ~200 ms and a 40 ms capture still contains a translucent ghost). Target windows are the union of two signals: every visible top-level window whose **process name** is `DeepSeek Harness`, and every window whose **title

- Screenshots **stay on this machine**: the host runs `powershell.exe` with a full-screen WinForms window and the image lives in memory; the chosen crop is handed to the DSH attachment library, and the temporary file used for transfer is deleted as soon as the browser has read it. The plugin makes no network requests.
- The plugin runs `powershell.exe -File helper.ps1 -ExecutionPolicy Bypass` with your user privileges (the script ships in the package and can be reviewed). It only hides and restores windows whose process name or title matches DSH; nothing else is touched.
- Insertion reuses DSH's own attachment path, so a shot travels exactly the same upload and save route as a pasted image.
- **Only three local traces exist**: the image object in the attachment library; `screenshots.json` in the session directory (filename, hash, size, session title — it answers "which conversation owns this shot"); and `%TEMP%\dsh-print-screen-helper.log`, which records timings, the number of hidden windows and **title lengths only** — never the titles themselves.
- **The diagnostic dump is off by default.** Only with `DSH_SCREENSHOT_FRAME_DUMP=1` set does a *cancelled* capture write the whole fro

```sh
node test.mjs          # route registration, cross-site rejection, one real capture (-SelfTest, fixed crop, no window)
node test-client.mjs   # button structure, Shift / Ctrl+Alt+1 detection, timestamped filenames
node test-route.mjs    # integration: real route + persistent helper + simulated drag, cold/warm latency
node --check client.js

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File test-helper.ps1   # helper: startup cost, warm latency, simulated drag
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File test-hide.ps1     # hide/restore check against a stand-in window
```

The helper protocol has a self-test mode (sixth field `1`: no window, fixed 320x200 crop); that is what `node test.mjs` uses.

> **When editing the scripts**: every `.ps1` must be saved as **UTF-8 with BOM**. Windows PowerShell 5.1 decodes a BOM-less script with the system ANSI code page (GBK on a Chinese system), which turns the overlay hint "拖动框选区域 · Esc 取消" into mojibake.

- Windows only.
- The freeze overlay is an ordinary top-most window, so in theory another top-most window can cover a corner of it.
- DSH is hidden while you capture; if the helper ever hangs (it is killed after a 5-minute timeout), DSH has to be restored by hand.
- **Never delete images from the attachment library by hand.** Messages reference them by hash, so removing an object makes the sessions that reference it fail and their images disappear. Use the "Delete Conversation" plugin so images are removed together with the conversation.
- **Case 1: delete an object from the library and that conversation is finished (measured).** Rename one object under `~/.dsh/attachments/v1/objects/` that a message references and the image in the history immediately turns into a "failed to load" placeholder. Send any further message and the model request retries five times before failing with `DeepSeek Messages transport failed` — **nothing in that error suggests a missing attachment**. Objects are addressed by hash, so deleting one removes part of the message, and there is no recycle bin; such a conversation cannot be repaired, only deleted (with the "Delete Conversation" plugin).
